model.catLabel: BA GK75 product page and spec (no public parts book)
model.note: Part outlines are traced from BA Pumps and Sprayers' product image and are approximate. The 12 V battery is not visible and is in the parts list. BA publishes no operator's manual or parts list online, so most parts are 'match the fitted part' and the Notion numbers are flagged unverified: ask BA (03 5278 9033) for the GK75 manual and parts list for serial D27058 and read the pump label first. The photo's boom may differ from the one fitted (1.5 m or 2 m).

tank.name: Spray tank (75 L)
tank.desc: 75 L polyethylene tank with a fully draining sump. After spraying triple-rinse the tank, flush the pump, lines and nozzles with clean water and drain through the drain tap; clean the outside. Chemical residue left in the lines blocks nozzles and perishes diaphragms: flush after every use. Winter storage: flush, run a pump-safe antifreeze or storage solution if there is a freezing risk.

lid.name: Tank lid and lid strainer
lid.desc: Keep the lid strainer in place when filling and the lid vent clear.

handle.name: Handle frame
handle.desc: Push frame and chassis. Annual: check the frame and boom hinges.

hoses.name: Hoses and clamps
hoses.desc: Monthly in use: inspect the hoses and clamps (stainless clamps only). Flush with clean water after every use.

controls.name: Control valves, pressure regulator and gauge
controls.desc: Before use the pressure regulator and gauge should read steady and the speedo should work. Calibrate monthly in use: catch-test each nozzle for 1 minute at working pressure and replace nozzles more than about 10 % above new flow (best practice).

pump.name: Pump and suction filter
pump.desc: 12 V Shurflo diaphragm pump, 13.6 L/min at 45 psi per BA. The old Notion number 8000-543-238 is listed as a 1.8 GPM (about 6.8 L/min) pump, half that flow: read the label on Green Sprayer 1's pump before ordering a pump or kits (the Notion valve kit 94-238-03 and pressure switch 94-375-15 are unverified and must match the fitted pump). Running dry damages the pump, and a dirty suction filter starves it. Suction filter: easy-access bowl, clean after every tank; mesh not stated by BA (the Notion '50 mesh, 80 option' is unverified), so match the fitted screen and replace it if hard or torn. Annual: check pump output and the pressure-switch cut-out; fit the Shurflo valve or diaphragm kit for the fitted model if the pump struggles.

battery.name: 12 V battery and charger
battery.desc: 12 V battery and charger supplied by BA (type and Ah not stated). Charge after every use. Monthly: check the battery terminals, harness and fuses. Winter: keep it on a maintenance charge.

tyres.name: Wheels and tyres
tyres.desc: Smooth pneumatic tyres: inflate them evenly so the boom sits level. Annual: check and grease the wheel bearings.

boommount.name: Boom mount and lift posts
boommount.desc: Annual: check the boom hinges. Monthly in use: check the boom is straight and level.

boom.name: Spray boom
boom.desc: 1.5 m boom on the GK75 or 2 m on the GK-75-2M (F suffix adds a foam marker): confirm which is fitted to serial D27058. Nozzles at 250 mm spacing on non-drip bodies with individual shut-offs. Before use run clean water through, check every nozzle pattern, the shut-offs work and there are no drips. Monthly: check the boom is straight and level and calibrate the nozzles.

nozzle.name: Nozzle body, tip and non-drip diaphragm
nozzle.desc: TeeJet low-drift air-induction nozzles at 250 mm spacing; tip size and colour are not stated by BA, so read the fitted tips and match them. Replace the set at the end of the season if worn (catch-test flow more than about 10 % above new). Replace the non-drip diaphragms if hard or torn; the Notion number TeeJet CP25598 is unverified: match it to the nozzle bodies fitted. Wash nozzles and filters after spraying.

hub.name: Wheel bearing
hub.desc: Annual: check and grease the wheel bearings.

8000-543-238.name: Shurflo pump (Notion number, conflict)
8000-543-238.note: Listed as a 1.8 GPM (about 6.8 L/min) pump; BA quotes 13.6 L/min for the GK75. Do not order until the fitted pump label is read.

94-238-03.name: Shurflo pump head / valve kit (Notion, unverified)
94-238-03.note: Must match the fitted pump model: confirm from the pump label.

94-375-15.name: Shurflo pressure switch (Notion, unverified)
94-375-15.note: Must match the fitted pump model: confirm from the pump label.

CP25598.name: TeeJet non-drip diaphragm check valve (Notion, unverified)
CP25598.note: Match to the nozzle bodies fitted.
